description: This file defines a GUI component for a behavioral coding application, including classes for buttons and a coding pad interface, with methods for configuration, display, and interaction handling.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A custom QWidget containing a QPushButton, used as a building block for the coding interface.

classes.name: CodingPad
classes.description: A QWidget-based class providing an interactive coding interface with buttons representing behaviors, supporting configuration, display, and event handling.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configures button appearance based on user selection.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Constructs the grid of behavior buttons based on filtered behaviors.

methods.name: addWidget
methods.description: Adds a behavior button to the grid at specified position.

methods.name: button_configuration
methods.description: Applies font size and color settings to behavior buttons.

methods.name: resizeEvent
methods.description: Handles resize events to update button appearance.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Emits a signal when a behavior button is clicked.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Intercepts key press events to forward to main window.
